model_scope.reference: Anthropic "Prompt caching", cache limitations, which enumerates the minimum cacheable prompt length per model by name; these are the models listed at this profile's tier. Model identifiers taken from Anthropic "Models overview", Claude API ID column. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview

summary: Messages API contract for the models with a documented 512-token minimum cacheable prompt length: Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Mythos 5.
coverage: Applies to the model identifiers named, on the Messages API. The tool and strict-tool-use rules are shared across every Anthropic profile in this dataset; the cache threshold is not, which is the reason these models are grouped separately rather than merged into one profile. Makes no claim about models it does not name.

provenance.reference: Anthropic "Prompt caching", cache limitations: the minimum cacheable prompt length is 512 tokens for Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Mythos 5. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching This check counts characters rather than tokenizing, so the token figure is carried as a character proxy of 2048 at roughly four characters per token — an estimate that will misjudge content tokenizing unusually. Not a provider-published character figure.

Heuristic. Caching on this surface is opt-in per request through cache_control, so a large stable prefix with no marker is never cached. Whether the prefix is actually stable across turns cannot be determined from a single request, which is why this is informational.
